title: Caller ID
intro: See your customers' names while the phone rings. Nothing is added to your contacts.
unsupported: This device does not support caller ID.
setup_done: Setup is complete. Your customers' names will appear when they call.
step_ios_extension_title: Turn on Olexfilms in the phone settings
step_ios_extension_2: Find Olexfilms in the list and turn its switch on.
step_ios_extension_3: Come back to this screen; the status updates by itself.
step_ios_extension_manual: If the button does not work: Settings → Apps → Phone → Call Blocking & Identification.
step_android_role_title: Make Olexfilms your caller ID app
step_android_role_2: In the window that opens, choose Olexfilms and confirm.
step_android_role_manual: If no window opens: Settings → Apps → Default apps → Caller ID & spam app.
step_android_overlay_2: Turn the permission on for Olexfilms and come back to this screen.
step_android_overlay_manual: If the button does not work: Settings → Apps → Special app access → Display over other apps.
list_truncated: The list is too large; only the first {{count}} numbers were loaded.
error_network: The list could not be updated. Check your internet connection.
error_forbidden: This account is not allowed to see the customer list.
error_failed: The list could not be updated. Try again later.
note_ios_delay: New customers are recognized within a few hours; opening the app updates the list at once.
note_android_contacts: No card is shown for numbers saved in your contacts; the phone shows its own entry.
note_android_battery: If the card does not appear, remove the battery restriction for Olexfilms in your phone's battery settings.
note_privacy: The list is kept on this device only. It is deleted when you turn the feature off or sign out.
